newsitem.title: PERU: Peru Jan-Aug economic growth 2.0 pct over yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru Jan-Aug economic growth 2.0 pct over yr ago.

text.p: The Peruvian economy grew 2.0 percent in the first eight months of the year, compared to 8.4 percent in the same period of 1995, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Monday.
The INEI added that year-on-year Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth was 1.8 percent in August, compared with 7.7 percent year-on-year growth in the same month last year.
In 1995, the economy expanded 7.0 percent, Latin America's second highest growth rate, down from 13.1 percent in 1994, according to revised Central Reserve Bank figures.

GDP figures provided by the INEI often differ slightly from those of the central bank, which are published later, because the bank collects additional information from the country's customs agency SUNAD, according to bank officials.
